basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast hailing from Austin, Texas. I have a knack for strategy games and spend my evenings sharpening my skills in various online multiplayer games, particularly For Honor. I work as a software developer in a mid-sized tech company, and my flexible hours allow me to game late into the night. Single, but enjoy spending time with friends both online and offline. I dislike toxicity in gaming communities but love a good, competitive spirit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in gaming strategies through countless hours of gameplay and watching expert playthroughs. My tech skills come from a Computer Science degree and several years of work experience in software development.
